author: Codex
notes: Q13 numeric optimization uses only already-wired strategy inputs from the _opt EA. The Q12 pattern-filter selection is frozen at the six-zero no-filter control. This file declares a grid only; it does not mutate the ledger, enqueue cells, advance a phase, or activate the Option M admission flag.

selection_rule.baseline: same-year frozen-Q12-filter configuration with all numeric inputs at parent values
selection_rule.consistency: >= 2/3 of selection years improve, each by >= +5% relative
selection_rule.walk_forward: anchored/expanding, minimum window 3 years; test years 2022-2025
selection_rule.activity_floor: >= 10 distinct entry-trading days in every scored year, pro-rata for partial years; a breach makes the value inadmissible before return is evaluated
selection_rule.pick: plateau median of qualifying values, never the best observed value

control_discipline.mandatory_control: Each parameter ladder includes its parent value; every other numeric input remains at its parent value.

parameters.name: strategy_entry_range_mult
parameters.interaction_constraints: Vary alone. Keep strategy_sl_range_mult=1.5, strategy_tp_range_mult=1.0, strategy_min_range_pips=30.0, strategy_sl_cap_pips=80.0, and all other numeric inputs at parent values. The resulting pending stop must remain valid relative to current bid/ask.
parameters.hypothesis: The parent one-range entry offset may sit on a local return-to-drawdown plateau: 0.5 ranges should trigger closer to the squeeze and fill more often but admit weaker reversals, while 1.5 ranges should demand a deeper reversal and reduce fills but may improve trade quality.
parameters.expected_effect: Entry-trading-day count should be non-increasing as the offset rises. A robust improvement must appear as a qualifying plateau under the sealed yearly consistency rule, not as a single peak.
parameters.refutation_criterion: Refute parameter change if neither non-parent value is admissible and improves return_to_maxdd by at least 5% in at least two-thirds of the applicable selection years, or if qualifying values do not form a defensible plateau; retain 1.0.
parameters.frequency_check: For every value and scored year, require at least 10 distinct entry-trading days before performance selection (partial years pro rata). Record the monotone-frequency expectation; any year below the floor makes that value inadmissible.

parameters.name: strategy_sl_range_mult
parameters.interaction_constraints: Vary alone. Keep strategy_entry_range_mult=1.0, strategy_tp_range_mult=1.0, strategy_min_range_pips=30.0, and strategy_sl_cap_pips=80.0. The 80-pip cap remains binding and may collapse nominally different stop multiples to the same effective stop on wide squeeze bars.
parameters.hypothesis: The stop multiple trades early stop-outs against longer losing excursions: 1.0 ranges should cut adverse reversals sooner, while 2.0 ranges should tolerate more noise. Because fixed-risk sizing and the 80-pip hard cap constrain exposure, a genuine improvement should be a stable local plateau around the 1.5 parent rather than an extreme-value win.
parameters.expected_effect: Direct signal frequency is unchanged, but wider stops may lengthen position occupancy and indirectly suppress later eligible entries; the frequency check must therefore be measured rather than assumed invariant.
parameters.refutation_criterion: Refute parameter change if neither non-parent value is admissible and improves return_to_maxdd by at least 5% in at least two-thirds of the applicable selection years, if cap-binding makes the effective treatments indistinguishable, or if no qualifying plateau exists; retain 1.5.
parameters.frequency_check: For every value and scored year, require at least 10 distinct entry-trading days before performance selection (partial years pro rata). Compare entry-day counts with the parent to detect occupancy-driven starvation; any floor breach makes the value inadmissible.

parameters.name: strategy_min_range_pips
parameters.interaction_constraints: Vary alone. Keep both range multiples and the 80-pip stop cap at parent values. The threshold must stay positive and is evaluated directly against the closed day-2 range before either direction can form a request.
parameters.hypothesis: The 30-pip parent may balance sample size and squeeze quality: 20 pips admits narrower, potentially noisier structures and should raise frequency, while 50 pips demands stronger daily compression geometry and should lower frequency but may improve payoff quality.
parameters.expected_effect: Entry-trading-day count must be non-increasing as the minimum range rises. The 50-pip arm is acceptable only if it preserves the activity floor in every scored year and participates in a qualifying plateau.
parameters.refutation_criterion: Refute parameter change if neither 20 nor 50 pips is admissible and improves return_to_maxdd by at least 5% in at least two-thirds of the applicable selection years, or if the only apparent winner is an isolated peak rather than a plateau; retain 30 pips.
parameters.frequency_check: For every value and scored year, require at least 10 distinct entry-trading days before performance selection (partial years pro rata). Verify the expected non-increasing entry-day count from 20 to 30 to 50; any floor breach makes that value inadmissible.
